strings.zh: 下面是自行车道{SCROLL}乘着自行车飞翔！{NEWLINE}享受飞奔下坡的乐趣吧！
strings.en: The Cycling Road is below!{SCROLL}Fly on your Bicycle! Enjoy the thrill of{NEWLINE}speeding downhill!
strings.notes: US 0354/0 | AGENT-0321-0380: Restore flying-on-your-bicycle exhortation and downhill location.

strings.zh: 自从暴走族被赶走之后,{NEWLINE}我就敢偷偷溜进自行车道玩了。{CLEAR}不过你可别跟入口的大叔告发我啊。{CLEAR}作为封口费,这个就送给你吧。
strings.en: Ever since the bike gang got chased{NEWLINE}off, I’ve dared to sneak onto the{CLEAR}Cycling Road to play.{SCROLL}But don’t tell the man at the entrance{NEWLINE}on me, okay?{SCROLL}Here, take this as hush money.
strings.notes: | AGENT-0321-0380: Restore newfound courage to sneak in, and explicit hush-money framing.
